task: You're looking for a venue with a staircase, columns, and a ballroom.
rationale: There's a split between luxury and classic. We're hoping a venue like this points people toward classic.

task: You have a large family and want to make sure there's enough space for them to park.
rationale: We removed the parking quantity because not very many venues had a number. We want to make sure it's still clear.

task: You're wanting a minimalistic venue, and you are looking forward to an exciting exit and a delicious cake.
target: Style(Modern), Features(Sparklers allowed), Decor(Specialty Stations(Cake table))
rationale: We want to make sure the facets match the needs of a potential user.

task: You're trying to find your perfect venue at the perfect price for you.
rationale: We'd like to know what users consider a perfect price. If there is consistency, we may add another view. All participants in the card sort said price was important to them. There may be a split with Budget Venues.

task: You want a whimsical wedding outside with lots of flowers.
rationale: We want to see whether users will use the outdoors style or feature more.

task: You're planning a wedding with lots of activities for guests.
rationale: We hope that specialty stations is a clear label for something that contains activities

task: You want an intimate setting for a small group.
target: Move Capacity slider to less than 200
rationale: We want to see what people consider a small group, and we hope the capacity label is clear.

task: You live in Provo and your grandma wants to come to the wedding, but she can't walk very well and sometimes uses a mobility device to get around.
rationale: We want to know if Wheelchair Accessible is too narrow of a label, and we wonder if people will use Explore or Locations.

task: You're a photographer, so you want your venue to look good in photos.
target: Style(Luxury), Decor(Aesthetics(one or more selected), Specialty Stations(photo booth/backdrop)
rationale: We want to test how Luxury is viewed and see if people go to Decor for venue type and not just items

task: Your uncle owns a restaurant and is bringing a feast as a wedding gift.
rationale: We want to see if users prefer to navigate via the homepage or the explore page for a specific scenario. We also want to make sure Outside Catering Allowed makes sense as a label.
